rationale: The original short thesis relied on price stalling beneath the 5-minute 9-EMA ($232.55), but LRCX has broken through that level and pushed to $233.08, just cents below the $233.20 hard invalidation. Exiting at market cuts the trade now that the technical resistance has failed, while declining bounce volume (down from 29k to 16k shares per minute) and overhead VWAP resistance ($235.49) in a weak broad market argue against flipping long.
